name: openclaw-spawner
description: Enables an Openclaw agent to spawn sub-agents (child Openclaw instances) when a task is too large, complex, or parallel to handle alone. Use this skill whenever an Openclaw agent needs to delegate work to another Openclaw agent, break a large task into concurrent sub-tasks, or hand off a portion of work mid-execution. Triggers include: task requires parallel execution, a sub-task is clearly separable from the main task, the agent detects it cannot complete the work alone within time/context limits, or the user asks to "spawn", "delegate", "parallelize", or "split" work across agents. Always use this skill — not ad-hoc improvisation — when spawning is needed.
